title: AtlaSent Trust Root Registry
description: Foundation Convergence Program (WS5). An INVENTORY of every signing purpose across the runtime and trust root — a superset of the published JWKS (atlasent-verifier-keys) that also records symmetric/unpublished signers and the provenance/self-test metadata whose ABSENCE caused the trust-plane defects (advertised-public-key != signer counterpart; runtime key_version != published kid; acceptance verifying the runtime self-reported key instead of the published trust root). DESIGN ARTIFACT: this schema defines the registry shape; it MUST NOT be populated with real key material here (atlasent-keys holds no private keys, and symmetric keys are never publishable). Full analysis: atlasent-docs/foundation/TRUST_PLANE_MAP.md.

kid.description: Canonical selector. For an asymmetric signer whose signatures are verified downstream, this MUST equal the runtime key_version/key_id that stamps the signature (the contract missing when runtime key_version=v1 diverged from published kid=v2-audit-2026).

key_version.description: Explicit alias of the runtime-stamped version, recorded separately because the published JWKS is additionalProperties:false with no alias field — which is why the selector break could not be expressed there.

role.description: Published trust-root role, when this signer is publishable.

purpose.description: Finer than role — multiple purposes collapse onto R2/R3 today.

symmetric.description: true for HMAC/shared-secret signers (permit pt.v2, bundle-manifest, request-auth). A symmetric signer is inventory-only and MUST NEVER be published to the JWKS or any public trust root.

publishable.description: Whether this signer's public half belongs in the published trust root. MUST be false whenever symmetric is true.

custody_source.description: Where the private/secret half lives — env-var name, KMS key ARN/id, or DB table. Provenance for audit; never the secret value.

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key (never the key material for symmetric signers).

selector_kind.description: How a verifier selects this key — makes the today-implicit selection contract explicit.

advertised_key_verified.description: Proof that the advertised public key is the true signer counterpart — the load-time sign->verify self-test result. Its absence on permit/export/proof/EGAS/approval signers is the open gap (only the audit signer has this today).

issuer.description: For R1/trust-root: the Sigstore identity + OIDC issuer. For derived keys: the deriving runtime.

source_bundle_sig.description: Link to the cosign .bundle that signs this registry entry, when published.

allOf.$comment: A symmetric signer must never be marked publishable.
